cropGuides.name: 🌾 Groundnut Cultivation (Anantapur's Lifeline)
cropGuides.time: Kharif season (June - July early monsoon rains)
cropGuides.details:
• Use 40-50 kg of certified seed per acre (Dharani, Kadiri varieties).
• Before sowing, treat seeds with 3 grams of Trichoderma viride or Carbendazim per kg of seed.
• Applying 200 kg of gypsum per acre while plowing is very important for firm pod formation and good yield.
• To prevent root rot, pour a Carbendazim solution at the roots of the plants.

cropGuides.name: 🥭 Mango Cultivation (Rayalaseema Special Banganapalli)
cropGuides.details:
• Keep 30x30 feet spacing between plants. For high-density planting, follow 15x15 feet.
• During the November-January flowering period, spray hexaconazole or sulfur to prevent powdery mildew caused by dew/cold.
• Use imidacloprid to control the hopper pest.

cropGuides.name: 🌱 Red Gram Cultivation (Profitable Intercrop)
cropGuides.time: June - July (in rows along with groundnut)
cropGuides.details:
• Sow 1 row of red gram after every 6 or 8 rows in a groundnut field.
• Mixing seeds with rhizobium culture before sowing produces nitrogen at the roots and improves soil fertility.
• Spray profenophos or emamectin benzoate to control the pod borer pest that attacks during the flowering and pod stages.

cropGuides.name: 🍊 Sweet Orange Cultivation (Horticultural Crop)
cropGuides.details:
• Cultivate only through drip irrigation in red soils.
• Spray micronutrients to correct zinc and iron deficiencies affecting the plants.
• Pour a copper oxychloride solution at the base of the plants to prevent root dry rot.

cropGuides.name: 🌾 Ragi & Jowar Cultivation (Drought-Resistant Millets)
cropGuides.details:
• Gives good yield even with low rainfall (400-500mm), lower risk than groundnut.
• 3-4 kg of seed per acre is enough — low investment.
• Applying 2 tonnes of farmyard manure per acre while preparing the land gives good yield.
• The government offers special support prices and subsidized seeds for millets — find out details through the RBK.
